description: MALAI: Estimate daily calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber from sex, age, height, weight, activity and goal, with MALAI's safety limits (a calorie floor and a cap on the rate of loss). Same calculator the MALAI app uses. Use for "how many calories should I eat on Wegovy", "what macros to lose 1 lb a week". Adults only. Don't use for a signed-in user's saved targets (that is malai_get_nutrition_targets).

activity.description: Daily activity: sedentary (desk, little exercise), light (1–3 workouts a week), moderate (3–5), very_active (6–7), athlete (training twice a day). Default light.

height.description: Height, in height_unit. Feet and inches must be converted to inches (5 ft 6 in = 66).

rate_per_week.description: Desired change per week, in weight_unit. Ignored for maintain. Default 0.5 kg (1.1 lb). Loss is capped for safety; the applied rate is returned as rate_per_week_kg.

sex.description: Sex used by the calorie formula.

weight_unit.description: Unit of weight and of rate_per_week.

name: malai_calculate_daily_targets
title: Calorie and macro targets
